description: This is a C# source file defining an ASP.NET Core MVC controller named AdminController for managing sitemaps within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It includes actions for listing, displaying, creating, editing, deleting, toggling, and bulk operations on sitemaps, with authorization checks and dependency injection.
